additional_concerns: The transition preserves an application process; it does not expressly establish permanent substantive ineligibility for the underlying change. Treating pending status at commencement as a lasting relief veto requires additional authority.

The introductory immediate-effect statement and the specific FAQ commencement date should be read together. The supplied text does not establish a universal implementation-date test or resolve every assessment event.
The supplied dependency IDs have no source hashes or identified document mappings. Neither can be treated as available or assigned to a particular missing authority.

Home requirements and the classifications novel, complex and possible local policy implications remain supplied judgments. Their application requires relevant home-jurisdiction rules and SFC guidance; the formulas do not establish those facts.
Failure of a removal condition does not independently establish an approval obligation. Notification, filing and post-vetting obligations remain separate.
